drivers.variant_notes: Bally D.01R prototype game ROM (Sound 0.25). In the retained auxiliary lamp probe it drives all sixteen auxiliary lamp addresses 91-98 and 101-108 through the 16-LED Skull Driver PCB's shift registers, clocking solenoids 37 and 38 from attract mode on.
